targets.rawSql: SELECT service AS id, service AS title, sum(calls) AS mainstat FROM (SELECT parent_service AS service, calls FROM tayga.service_edges WHERE $__timeFilter(minute) UNION ALL SELECT child_service AS service, calls FROM tayga.service_edges WHERE $__timeFilter(minute)) GROUP BY service

SELECT concat(parent_service, '->', child_service) AS id, parent_service AS source, child_service AS target, sum(calls) AS mainstat, sum(errors) AS secondarystat FROM tayga.service_edges WHERE $__timeFilter(minute) GROUP BY parent_service, child_service

SELECT concat(parent_service, '->', child_service) AS id, parent_service AS source, child_service AS target, sum(calls) AS total_calls, sum(errors) AS total_errors, round(sum(errors) / sum(calls) * 100, 2) AS error_pct, round(sum(duration_ns_sum) / sum(calls) / 1e6, 1) AS avg_ms FROM tayga.service_edges WHERE $__timeFilter(minute) GROUP BY parent_service, child_service ORDER BY total_calls DESC
